description: React component for displaying and managing attachments in a trace viewer, including image diffs, screenshots, and text attachments.

classes.name: ExpandableAttachment
classes.description: React component for expandable attachment view, including text and download link.

methods.name: isEqualAttachment
methods.description: Checks if an attachment matches an AfterActionTraceEventAttachment based on name, path, and sha1.

methods.name: attachmentURL
methods.description: Generates URL for an attachment, optionally with query parameters.

methods.name: downloadURL
methods.description: Generates download URL for an attachment with content type and name parameters.

methods.name: attachmentKey
methods.description: Creates a unique key for an attachment based on index and sha1 or path.
